description: Capability for the main window. SCOPE DECISIONS (WP-R, verified 2026-08-18): READ side (read-file/read-dir/stat/watch/unwatch) deliberately stays at ** — the library folder is an arbitrary user-chosen path (localStorage pdfer:libdir) scanned via readDir+watchImmediate on every launch, and pdfer:last auto-reopens the previous book at startup, both WITHOUT a dialog. Dialog-granted paths cannot cover this: tauri-plugin-dialog adds picked paths to the fs scope at runtime (commands.rs allow_file/allow_directory), but that scope is an in-memory Mutex<HashSet<Pattern>> (tauri/src/scope/fs.rs ScopeInner.allowed_patterns) and is lost on restart; persistence would require the tauri-plugin-persisted-scope crate, which this app does not ship. Narrowing read to $APPDATA would break library + last-book reopen after every restart. WRITE side is narrow: $APPDATA/** for stores/glossaries/models/markers, plus $DOWNLOAD/** under fs:allow-write-file as a DELIBERATE exception — one-click «Экспорт перевода» writes the HTML straight to the Downloads folder without a save dialog (src/export.ts exportTranslationToDownloads). mkdir/remove/rename stay $APPDATA-only. WINDOW: core:window:allow-destroy is REQUIRED, not optional — App.tsx registers onCloseRequested, which makes tauri's core prevent_close() the native close (manager/window.rs) and hand the real close to the JS wrapper's window.destroy(); core:window:default does NOT include allow-destroy, so without this line the ACL answers 'Command plugin:window|destroy not allowed by ACL' into a promise nobody reads and the titlebar X does nothing at all (measured on the release build: window still up 15s after WM_CLOSE; adding this one line alone brought it down to 1.25s). own_shutdown() in lib.rs owns the X regardless — it has to, because destroy() closes only the main window and leaves a hidden pdf-print-N export window holding the process up — so this permission is the fast path, not the only one; do not drop either half. core:window:allow-set-title is likewise absent from core:window:default.
